title: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 8GB/256GB $599, Redmi Note 17 Pro 6GB/256GB $499 + Bonus Xiaomi 120W Charger Combo Delivered @ Xiaomi
body:
Deal: Redmi Note 17 Pro Max 8GB/256GB $599, Redmi Note 17 Pro 6GB/256GB $499 + Bonus Xiaomi 120W Charger Combo Delivered @ Xiaomi

[RichardL] Interesting that they skipped 16 and went from Redmi Note 15 to 17.
I suspect to match iPhones/trick buyers into buying a '17 Pro'/'17 Pro Max'.
[MiscOzB] Did the same with Xiaomi 15 to 17 series, and yeah I think the iPhone thing was exactly the reason.
[HaydosK] I don't need this phone but damn is $399 good for those specs. The battery probably lasts forever. Also the cheapest way to get the lastest snapdragon chip until the gen 6 comes out next month and it will probably be redmagic again.
[BlueGlowOne] https://m.gsmarena.com/our_redmi_note_17_pro_battery_life_an…
[BargainsGrabber] Xiaomi is also running a spend and receive promo too
The 8Gb + 512GB Note 17 Pro Max is eligible to receive a free Xiaomi Smart Camera C500
[MiscOzB] Same prices at Mobileciti for just the phones but with an extra 5% off with code MCGSAUG26
[chewkl] I’m interested in this but recent reports of bloatware on Xiaomi phones turned me off. Is this confirmed to be a concern or non-issue?
I have a Lenovo Pad Pro GT and even though all bloatware has been uninstalled or disabled, new ones keep coming up from time to time.
[mangobango] Can't speak for Redmi specifically but my Xiaomi 17T Pro does have some bloatware (proprietary Xiaomi apps like file manager, Mi Mover etc, but also things like Google One and YT Music) but really most can be disabled/ignored.
Yeah there'll be an extra few apps in the app drawer but it's never bothered me.
[scottySK] $399 with complimentary screen and battery replacement is incredible value if true
[knobbs] You used to be the chosen one Xiaomi! You used to include SD card slots!
[spaij] Ah, so that's why it's $200 to go from 256 to 512.
[Merlict] They still do on budget models, the 17 non pro has one
[Nillionaire] Which was holding them back from being seen as a flagship. They'll still have them on the budget and maybe some midrange models.
[Castcore] These are insane value, what a rort from the big companies.
[ChrisInMelbourne] Xiaomi is the third largest phone manufacturer and growing
[Nillionaire] Globally sure but pretty sure Pixel, Moto and Oppo have more marketshare in Australia than Xiaomi
[ozchobie] Great specs for the price. Would be the perfect phone for parents, if only it had telephoto, my parents like using the zoom function.
[WatchNerd] Why just parents? Most people don't need a 1K+ phone & the battery is a game changer.
[temptingdeals90] Missed the registration for free buds. Anyone registered but not wanting to buy? I m keen to get pro max
[mutnyi2001] if they included wireless charging and dropped the weight of the phone it would be a no brainer
[jolt] I'm surprised that 12GB of RAM hasn't become more commonplace, is that just because of the increased price of RAM? Or is 8GB generally enough with modern CPUs?
[Merlict] Insane ram pricing, they can't afford to outside of flagships
[brifog] Extra $30 off with code RN17APP when you purchase through the mi app.
[Brianqpr] Currently on a pixel 8 pro which I like a lot but have had earlier versions of these Xiaomi phones and they were great. I especially miss the excellent battery life.
Camera was probably a weak spot, is this still the case?
